name: WW2 Rebuilder: Remagen and Caen
summary:
Prepare for the biggest challenge in WW2 Rebuilder!
The Remagen and Caen DLC brings you two spectacular locations, filled with dramatic history and unique reconstruction tasks.

Remagen – where a single bridge changed the course of the war.
Caen – the heart of Normandy, rebuilt from the ground up after devastating battles.

Enter shattered cities, clear the ruins, restore key structures, and bring life back to places once swallowed by destruction. Each mission brings new tools, new mechanics, fresh challenges, and surprising details that make every brick count.

Two cities. Two stories. One mission:
build the future on the ashes of the past.

Discover new areas, meet the locals, and make decisions that shape the post-war world. This DLC is the perfect reason to return to WW2 Rebuilder and experience it on a whole new scale.

Restore the glory of Remagen and Caen — and prove that hope can be rebuilt even after the darkest times.
